import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import time

root = Path.cwd()
task = root / '.local/tool-tasks/cross-member-snapshot-20261006'
prior = root / '.local/tool-tasks/excess-star-hook-20261006/full-production-two'
host = task / 'harness-build/OfflineSearchHarness.dll'
dll = root / '.local/tool-tasks/upstream-pr213-sync-20261006/build/CombatSolver.dll'
env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('OFFLINE_HARNESS_', 'COMBATSOLVER_VERIFY', 'COMPlus_Jit', 'DOTNET_Jit', 'COMPlus_PerfMap', 'DOTNET_PerfMap'))}
env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_COMBATSOLVER_DLL'] = str(dll)
env['OFFLINE_HARNESS_SNAPSHOT_PROBE'] = 'request-families'
rows = []
provenance = {'observationOnly': True, 'hostSha256': hashlib.sha256(host.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'runtimeBaselineSha256': '2aa06f3e5adfc9e82492d2a43c806f2b3aa1964e92b9c250da013ffa2d68e45e', 'sourceHead': '1d92b01d', 'mode': 'request-families', 'launcherTimeoutSeconds': 120, 'diagnosticTimesAreNotPerformance': True}
(task / 'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + '\n')
for scene in ['dev-08-regent-boss', 'dev-09-necrobinder-boss']:
    output = task / scene
    output.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    command = json.loads((prior / (scene + '-A1') / 'command.json').read_text())
    command[1] = str(host)
    command[command.index('--label') + 1] = scene + '-request-families'
    command[command.index('--out') + 1] = str(output)
    (output / 'command.json').write_text(json.dumps(command, indent=2) + '\n')
    started = time.monotonic()
    with (output / 'launcher.log').open('w') as log:
        child = subprocess.Popen(command, env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            code = child.wait(timeout=120)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=10)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                child.wait()
            (output / 'timeout.json').write_text(json.dumps({'timeoutSeconds': 120, 'childExitCode': child.returncode, 'completedEvidence': False}) + '\n')
            raise
    if code != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f'{scene} diagnostic exit {code}; see launcher.log')
    observation = json.loads((output / 'snapshot-request-families.json').read_text())
    result = json.loads((output / 'harness-result.json').read_text())
    row = {'scene': scene, 'processWallSeconds': time.monotonic() - started, 'request': observation['request'], 'families': len(observation['families']), 'comparisonQuality': result['comparisonQuality'], 'work': result['solverMetrics'], 'timeBoundaryObserved': result['timeBoundaryObserved']}
    rows.append(row)
    (task / 'runs.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'scene': scene, 'diagnosticOnly': True, 'processWallSeconds': row['processWallSeconds'], 'request': {k: v for k, v in row['request'].items() if k != 'Mismatches'}, 'families': row['families']}, ensure_ascii=False), flush=True)
